old_ambiguous_description: Original construct-level logFC from BCalm topTreat versus scrambled controls; not an allelic contrast or phenotype risk.
correct_description: Original unshifted BCalm fitted construct log2 RNA/DNA activity coefficient. The scrambled-control choice determines TREAT statistics; the released logFC is not the difference from the scrambled-control mean. Not an allelic contrast or phenotype risk.
why: BCalm fits element intercepts on the log2 RNA/DNA scale. mpra_treat centers a local coefficient copy to calculate control-based statistics, while returning unshifted coefficients. The source CLI writes topTreat logFC values.
